rule: Whenever you fix anything, make sure we don't degrade: test each fix before going on to the next one, and keep only what shows improvement, in percentages, over the previous release.
operator: "Whenever you fix anything make sure that we don't degrade. We have to only see improvement, like improvement in percentages. We need to see better results Whatever you fix just try to test it before jumping into another test."
chose: Integrate Wave A one branch at a time: measure a v0.34.1 baseline first, merge one wave-a branch, run its gates and compare to the baseline in percentages, and merge the next only when nothing has degraded; a branch that regresses any measure is held out and sent back.
over: Merging all 8 wave-a branches onto release/0.35.0 and gating the combined result once
because: The operator requires that every fix be proven before the next one is tried and that results only improve. A one-shot merge hides which item caused a regression, and a pass/fail gate with no baseline cannot show improvement as a percentage.
